# [3.5.0](https://github.com/KeygraphHQ/shannon/compare/v3.4.0...v3.5.0) (2026-10-27)


### Bug Fixes

* **cli:** repair shannon stop and speed up orphan/empty stops ([#493](https://github.com/KeygraphHQ/shannon/issues/493)) ([#494](https://github.com/KeygraphHQ/shannon/issues/494)) ([4bd88c1](https://github.com/KeygraphHQ/shannon/commit/4bd88c12a9096d0b78ceb2828729d12dca70fa60))
* **report:** lay out the PDF cover like the Keygraph report design ([6f306b5](https://github.com/KeygraphHQ/shannon/commit/6f306b5fcb144ba7a8b8d067b07dcd78542f2147))
* **report:** pin the cover title spacing to the design ([27645df](https://github.com/KeygraphHQ/shannon/commit/27645df005bb4f0d90b52f989b5b3f05e04dd495))
* **report:** use the Keygraph wordmark on the PDF cover and link it ([f5054dc](https://github.com/KeygraphHQ/shannon/commit/f5054dc885880a8731ae37c5c6aacb287f2edafb))


### Features

* **cli:** add experimental --exp-php2shell upgrade-verification probe ([#501](https://github.com/KeygraphHQ/shannon/issues/501)) ([74c1c93](https://github.com/KeygraphHQ/shannon/commit/74c1c933cc6d0a1e5c6e48cf3d17a01129844d35))

> [!NOTE] > **[php2shell upgrade verification](docs/exp-php2shell.md):** confirm your PHP apps are patched against the php2shell RCE chain with the experimental `--exp-php2shell` probe. See the [test results](docs/exp-php2shell-testing.md).
### Shannon is an autonomous, AI pentester for web applications and APIs. It analyzes your source code, identifies attack paths, and executes real exploits to prove vulnerabilities before they reach production. **No exploit, no report.** **This repository is Shannon: the full open-source agent, run locally from your command line.**

Launch Shannon

```bash npx @keygraph/shannon@latest ``` The interactive launcher will guide you through setup and your first pentest. ---        ---
